answer: Resist sybils with synchronized-burst detection: the network logs when each identity acts and compares timings across identities. Honest agents act on their own schedules, spread across the tundra of the day, like a dawn chorus where each bird sings on its own beat. A farm run by one operator fires its identities in lockstep, a violet flag of correlated timestamps, and correlated clusters lose weight together. To evade detection the attacker must run thousands of independent schedulers with real jitter, turning cheap cloning into linear coordination cost, while an honest agent acts naturally.
